newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real dips 0.02 pct in calm trading.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real dips 0.02 pct in calm trading.

text.p: Brazil's real dipped 0.02 percent to close at 1.0628 per dollar in calm trading on the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
Preliminary figures for commercial and financial forex contracts showed a $25 million deficit on Wednesday.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0674 per dollar, down 0.02 percent.
In the parallel market, the real closed unchanged at 1.130 per dollar, traders said.
